description: Na₂Bi₄O₇ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 5-coordinate geometry to five O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.28-2.50 Å. There are two inequivalent Bi sites. In the first Bi site, Bi is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.11-2.30 Å. In the second Bi site, Bi is bonded in a distorted rectangular see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Bi-O bond distances ranging from 2.07-2.37 Å. There are four inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Bi atoms to form a mixture of corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Bi₂ trigonal pyramids. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to three Bi atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Bi atoms. In the fourth O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Bi atoms to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₂Bi₂ tetrahedra.
